description: Resets the layout of an item.

finalLayout.description: Specifies layout to be reset. If 'true', the final layout is reset, otherwise - shared layout.

id.description: The ID of the item to reset the layout for. Supply this or path.

language.description: Specifies the item language to reset layout for.

path.description: The path of the item to reset the layout for. Supply this or id.

name: presentation-reset-layout
